title: Climb For Animals Eggs Wiki
seo_title: Climb For Animals Eggs Wiki: Eggs, Stamina and Rebirth
meta_description: Climb For Animals Eggs: grab guarded eggs, hatch them at your base and earn Cash from every animal. Know when guards sleep and how to reach Winter early.
description_md:
Climb the wall to take guarded eggs home and hatch them into animals. Place those animals at your base and they earn Cash, even while you're offline.

Train Speed on the treadmill to climb faster, and buy Stamina at the Stamina Shop to unlock new zones. Expanding your base lets you hold more animals, and every new one goes into your Index. Rebirth resets your Speed in exchange for a permanent Cash multiplier.
tips_md:
- Two Stamina Shop boosts get you to Winter. You start with 20 Stamina, and the first boost costs $100 in Cash and adds 4. Two of them take you to 28, which is Winter's requirement.
- Grab an egg while its guard is asleep. The guard only naps for 15 seconds, so don't stop to admire the egg. Then jump down into the Safe Zone instead of climbing all the way back, and run the egg to your base.
- Claim the Speed reward on every new Index entry. It's free progress on top of the Cash the animal earns, and that Speed carries into your next climb.
- Like the game and join 100% GRIND for a one-time +10K Speed reward. Claim it at the chest beside the Mutate Machine in the Safe Zone.
